mapper.select: SELECT ccm.mach_id machId, ccm.company_id companyId, ccm.dept_id deptId, ccm.mach_sn machSn, ccm.start_date startDate, ccm.end_date endDate, ccm.create_time createTime, ccm.mach_status machStatus, ccm.status_time statusTime, ccm.oper_user_id operUserId, cc.company_name companyName, cum.user_id userId, DATE_FORMAT( cum.binding_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) bindingTime, cum.binding_status bindingStatus, cu.user_name userNmae, csu.user_name operUserName, cd.dept_name deptName FROM ( SELECT tt.mach_id , tt.company_id , tt.dept_id , tt.mach_sn , tt.mach_type , DATE_FORMAT( tt.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) start_date, DATE_FORMAT( tt.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) end_date, DATE_FORMAT( tt.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) create_time, ifnull(tt.mach_status, 1) mach_status, DATE_FORMAT( tt.status_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) status_time, tt.oper_user_id FROM comm_company_mach tt INNER JOIN ( SELECT mach_sn, max(mach_id) mach_id FROM comm_company_mach WHERE dept_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT dept_id FROM comm_user_mng_dept WHERE user_id = #{loginUserId} ) GROUP BY mach_sn ) s ON s.mach_sn = tt.mach_sn AND s.mach_id = tt.mach_id ) ccm LEFT JOIN comm_company cc ON cc.company_id = ccm.company_id LEFT JOIN comm_dept cd ON cd.dept_id = ccm.dept_id LEFT JOIN cust_user_mach cum ON ccm.mach_sn = cum.mach_sn AND IFNULL(cum.binding_status, 0) = 1 LEFT JOIN cust_userinfo cu ON cum.user_id = cu.user_id LEFT JOIN comm_system_user csu ON csu.user_id = ccm.oper_user_id where mach_id=#{machId} and mach_status=1
